contraindications: Anticoagulant or antiplatelet therapy such as warfarin or aspirin (antiplatelet activity may increase bleeding risk)
planned surgery (discontinue at least two weeks beforehand due to bleeding risk)
autoimmune conditions (immunostimulant activity may theoretically worsen disease activity)
diabetes medications (may lower blood glucose and increase hypoglycemia risk)
pregnancy or breastfeeding without clinician guidance (insufficient safety data)
